summary.text: Clarke Tucker, a Democrat from Little Rock, represents Arkansas Senate District 14, which runs from downtown Little Rock through Chenal Parkway.

paragraphs.text: He was elected to the Senate in November 2020 and previously served in the Arkansas House of Representatives from 2015 to 2019.
Tucker earned a B.A. in government from Harvard University in 2003 and a J.D. from the University of Arkansas School of Law in 2006.
He has practiced law in Little Rock since 2008, after a two-year judicial clerkship, and also serves as a mediator.
